executionEvidence.caseStatusBasis: The executed line reporter listed all 19 cases and ended with 19 passed and exit code 0; the persisted last-run file confirms passed with no failed tests.

linuxCI.server: Build first, then start node scripts/serve-lan.mjs --port 5173.
linuxCI.command: IPAD_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chromium npx playwright test tests/ipad-touch.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line --output=test-results/ipad-touch

limitations: No physical iPad, Safari on iPadOS, finger or Apple Pencil was operated; these are desktop-engine simulations.
WebKit continuous gestures are mouse Pointer events, not a continuous iPad touch stream; multi-finger and browser-native touch-scroll coverage is Chromium CDP only.
The writing test uses the character 一 and explicit SVG CSS scaling; this does not certify every stroke dataset or handwritten character.
Synthetic profiles and saved checkpoints are testing fixtures, not evidence of a child learning or mastery.
Native Home Screen installation, real safe-area insets, standalone launch and audio quality are outside this touch audit.
